projects.name: Apex FSD - StormHacks 2026 (Winner)
projects.description: An AI that drives Forza Horizon by physically turning a real steering wheel, and lets go the instant a human grabs it. Won Best Python Hack at Western Canada's largest hackathon.

projects.name: Email Synced Cashflow Tracker
projects.description: Sales and inventory tracker for my clothing resale business across Grailed, Depop, and eBay. A Go worker listens for sale emails through Gmail push and Pub/Sub and logs each order on its own, and Redis caching makes the stats dashboards 20.6x faster.

projects.name: Scheming - HackMIT 2026
projects.description: AI agents play Mafia/Werewolf against each other. Scheming reads their private reasoning and flags the exact line where an agent says one thing and plans another.

projects.name: GitIntent - UC Berkeley AI LLM Hackathon 2026
projects.description: A shared memory for AI coding agents, which otherwise start every session with no record of what the last one tried. Every attempt is saved with the reasoning behind it, and agents with access solved 8.3% more tasks on the DeepSWE benchmark than the same agent without.

projects.name: YouTube Shorts AI Optimizer
projects.description: An AI copilot that watches a draft YouTube Short and predicts the second viewers will swipe away, before it's ever posted. Built on a channel that reached 45M views, its predictions beat a veteran creator's instincts, and 100+ creators have used it.

projects.name: Premier Predictor
projects.description: A Random Forest model trained on years of scraped Premier League data to predict match results. Built to find out whether a model could beat the pundits' track record.

projects.name: Java OOP Quiz Application
projects.description: A quiz app for CPSC 210 where the codebase doubles as the study material: every class and interface in it demonstrates a principle the course tests. Used by classmates to prepare for the final.

projects.name: Vital-Sense Radar
projects.description: A heart rate and breathing monitor that uses Wi-Fi alone and can detect through walls. Two ESP32 boards detect the tiny signal disturbances caused by a chest rising and falling, with no camera, wearable, or contact.

projects.name: Chelsea FC Play Predictor
projects.description: Seven models that each predict a different event in the next Chelsea match, fed by a pipeline that pulls and prepares every game automatically. An expected-value optimizer ranks which predictions are worth acting on.

projects.name: Photo Time Capsule
projects.description: A shared photo album that seals after friends fill it and opens for everyone at once later, with comment threads to relive it. Built in a hackathon weekend with React Native and Firebase.

projects.name: Minecraft Data Science Project
projects.description: A research server logged everything its Minecraft players did, and this project uses that data to predict which players would go on to subscribe. Play patterns turned out to be a reliable signal.
